rows.cite: playback/src/player.rs:947,951; playback/Cargo.toml:88 (feature flac, for local files)
rows.detail: Used for local files only; not a negotiated CDN format at this pin.
Raw ALAC packets plus the 24-byte cookie; the vector's cookie comes from Apple's encoder (frame length 4096), the pin's from shairport (352); the decoder reads the length from the cookie.
24-bit values compared exactly to the source signal.
Raw frames with an AudioSpecificConfig; priming and padding belong to the sender's RTP timestamps, not the decoder.

rows.blocked_by: no admitted multichannel render path and no admitted downmix: the speaker renders stereo, and A01 must not advertise a capability the build does not implement; independently, the pinned Symphonia AAC decoder refuses more than two channels (symphonia-codec-aac aac/mod.rs:91-96, "aac too complex")
rows.detail: Kept as a named requirement. The adapter refuses it with an explicit error BEFORE decoding (negative vector); it becomes supported only through an admission test, never by silent downmix.
No codec: big-endian bytes to samples; held to the source signal bit for bit.

rate_boundary.rule: A decoder output keeps its native rate. 48 kHz is direct; 44.1 kHz reaches the renderer only through the exact 160/147 rate bridge; any other rate is an explicit refusal. D03's drift resampler (+-500 ppm, hard cap 10000 ppm) is NOT a rate converter.

known_gaps.what: The pinned Symphonia AAC decoder sets asc.sbr_present when an ID_FIL element carries SBR data (aac/mod.rs:194) and nothing acts on it afterwards, so an HE-AAC stream signalled only in-band decodes as its LC core with the SBR payload ignored.
known_gaps.covered: Explicit signalling (an ASC with object type 5, 29, 23 or the ELD escape) is refused by name by admission and by parse_aac_asc.
known_gaps.not_covered: In-band-only signalling cannot be seen without parsing raw data blocks; no test claims it is caught. The pinned AirPlay sender negotiates AAC-LC (ADTS profile 2) with an explicit ASC.
